description.en: Generic original eroded volcanic conduit remnant geological form informed by NPS Beacon Rock photograph and volcanic-neck explanation. Not exact Beacon Rock, sacred-site reconstruction, measured locality, DEM, eruption simulation or geological period. Nominal540x490x360m full-volume illustrative module includes a broad low eroded foot around a narrower approximately240m high steep resistant core. Crown is solid irregular rock with no crater. Vegetation and river shown in source are not reconstructed.
